graveyard.value: konami-glitch
graveyard.epitaph: A borrowed gesture. The Konami code belongs to a different culture and a different kind of nostalgia. It never connected to the metallurgical thread or the Portuguese thread. It was decoration pretending to be personality. Replaced in spirit by debasement-hover, which does the same destabilizing work but from within the site's own logic.

graveyard.value: Cupellation: you heat the impure metal in a shallow cup of bone ash. The lead oxidizes, soaks into the porous cup, and what remains is a tiny bright bead of pure silver. The cup is ruined. The thing that holds the process is consumed by it. Every honest container is.
graveyard.epitaph: Thinning the night pool. 22 is absurd for a max-10 constraint.

graveyard.name: metallurgy
graveyard.epitaph: The metallurgy epoch proved the evolutionary system works. 11 generations, 20 kills, a touchstone simulator, canvas animations, five interaction patterns invented and three killed. It did its job: it proved the organism can evolve. Now it sheds its skin entirely.
